comment: Schematic drawn by Tasa (2006), corrected by monkeyxx. Image 10 is Patrick Johnson's layout with a parts list adapted to Tremulator values by monkeyxx (its designators differ from the schematic's, and it uses TL07x op amps where the schematic has LF351/LF442/TL061); image 11 is the PCB transfer artwork.
uncertain: The Speed pot is drawn as 1k; the layout's parts list gives the Rate pot as 500K linear, so the drawn value is probably wrong.
The Depth pot is drawn as 50k; the layout's parts list gives 100K linear.
The trimmer before the optocoupler is labeled something like P1 / 5k; the layout gives the optoisolator bias trim VR1 as 5K.
The optocoupler is drawn as UTL5C1, read here as VTL5C1.
